name: MOT_RESOURCE_QUOTAS_INT
description: Interface table for supporting resource quota import

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Externally generated id to mark actual set of imported records

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: An internally generated identifier for interface table. It is part of the primary key

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the import status of the record

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: This column is to handle the null action code

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: File record number

columns.name: INTERNAL_OVN
columns.description: This is used for optimistic locking

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: Indicates import sys task id for multi CSV upload

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: This column would be populated by consumer when there is any error in PLSQL

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: QUOTA_PLAN_NAME
columns.description: Name of the quota plan for which the territory quota is updated. Part of user key

columns.name: TERRITORY_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identification number for this territory. Part of user key

columns.name: RESOURCE_EMAIL
columns.description: Email of the resource. Part of user key

columns.name: GOAL_NUMBER
columns.description: Associated goal. Part of user key

columns.name: RESOURCE_QUOTA_ID
columns.description: Identifier of resource quota

columns.name: TERRITORY_QUOTA_ID
columns.description: Identifier of territory quota

columns.name: QUOTA_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Identifier of quota plan

columns.name: TERRITORY_VERSION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of territory

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of resource

columns.name: GOAL_ID
columns.description: Identifier of goal

columns.name: RESOURCE_QUOTA
columns.description: Quota allocated to a resource

columns.name: ALLOCATION_COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments on resource quota allocation

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
